title: Cebu inflation eases due to slower food price increases

blocks.text: LAPU-LAPU CITY, Cebu — Cebu Province and its highly urbanized cities posted lower inflation rates in August 2026, as prices of food and non-alcoholic beverages increased at a slower pace than the previous month, according to the Philippine Statistics Authority in Central Visayas (PSA-7). Data from PSA-7 showed that inflation in Cebu Province eased to 9.5 percent in August 2026 from 10.9 percent in July 2026. Cebu City’s inflation eased to 7.4 percent from 8.4 percent in July, Lapu-Lapu City dropped to 4.7 percent from 5.7 percent, and Mandaue City slowed to 5.9 percent from 6.6 percent.
